# City Stone Houses Kalymnos

> Two traditional, fully renovated stone-house apartments in Pothia, the harbour town of Kalymnos, Dodecanese, Greece. Each apartment is rented as a whole, sleeps up to 5 guests, and has 2 bedrooms, a full kitchen and a washing machine. Contactless self check-in. Direct booking available.
> Δύο παραδοσιακά πέτρινα διαμερίσματα στην Πόθια, το λιμάνι της Καλύμνου. Έως 5 άτομα το καθένα.

## Apartments
- City Stone House 1: first-floor apartment, 2 bedrooms, up to 5 guests. Wi-Fi, air conditioning, washing machine, full kitchen, coffee maker, toaster, TV, baby cot. Private entrance, no shared spaces.
- City Stone House 2: ground-floor apartment with private yard and BBQ, 2 bedrooms, up to 5 guests. Wi-Fi, air conditioning, washing machine, full kitchen, coffee maker, toaster, TV, baby cot. Private entrance, no shared spaces.
- Price is per whole apartment (up to 5 guests), with no extra charge per person.

## Location
- Address: Ypapantis 3 (Υπαπαντής 3), Pothia, Kalymnos 852 00, Greece
- Quiet traditional neighbourhood in the centre of Pothia, about 10 minutes from the ferry port.
- Restaurants, cafés, supermarket, bakery, shops, pharmacies, museums, taxi and bus stop within 30-100 metres.
- Vouvali beach: 3-5 minutes on foot. Kasonia beach: 5-10 minutes on foot.
- Masouri (main climbing area): 9 km, 20-30 minutes by scooter or car.
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/okfSSR6L3PaDdFaJ8

## Stay details
- Check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00.
- Contactless self check-in via key box.
- Best rates when booking directly with us (see website).
